description: Documentation source for the `BrowserContext` class in Playwright, detailing its properties, events, methods, parameters, and usage examples. It describes how to manage multiple browser contexts, their events, request routing, permissions, cookies, and script injection.

methods.name: addCookies
methods.description: Adds cookies into this browser context. All pages within this context will have these cookies installed. Cookies can be obtained via the `cookies` method.

methods.name: addInitScript
methods.description: Adds a script which would be evaluated in situations such as page creation, navigation, or frame attachment, before any page scripts run. Useful to preprocess or seed environment variables like Math.random.

methods.name: backgroundPages
methods.description: Returns an empty list as background pages have been removed from Chromium with Manifest V2 extensions.

methods.name: browser
methods.description: Retrieves the browser instance that owns this context, or null if outside a normal browser environment.

methods.name: clearCookies
methods.description: Removes cookies from the context. Can filter by name, domain, or path.

methods.name: clearPermissions
methods.description: Clears all permission overrides for the browser context.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the browser context, closing all its pages and cleaning up resources.

methods.name: cookies
methods.description: Retrieves all cookies associated with this context, optionally filtered by URLs.

methods.name: exposeBinding
methods.description: Exposes a callback as a function on the window object of all pages in this context, which can be called from page scripts.

methods.name: exposeFunction
methods.description: Adds a JavaScript function available on the window object of all pages in this context that executes a callback.

methods.name: grantPermissions
methods.description: Grants specified permissions to the browser context, optionally scoped to a particular origin.

methods.name: newCDPSession
methods.description: Creates a new Chrome DevTools Protocol session for the given page or frame, Chromium only.

methods.name: newPage
methods.description: Creates a new page (tab) within this browser context.

methods.name: pages
methods.description: Returns all open pages within this context.

methods.name: removeAllListeners
methods.description: Removes all event listeners of a given type or all listeners if no type specified.

methods.name: route
methods.description: Sets up request routing; matching requests are intercepted and can be modified, fulfilled, or aborted.

methods.name: routeFromHAR
methods.description: Serves network requests from a HAR file, enabling replay of recorded network activity within this context.

methods.name: routeWebSocket
methods.description: Modifies WebSocket connections made by pages in this context, allowing to intercept and handle WebSocket messages.

methods.name: serviceWorkers
methods.description: Retrieves all service workers currently registered in this context (Chromium only).

methods.name: setDefaultNavigationTimeout
methods.description: Sets the default maximum navigation time for methods like goto, reload, etc.

methods.name: setDefaultTimeout
methods.description: Configures the timeout for methods accepting a timeout parameter.

methods.name: setExtraHTTPHeaders
methods.description: Sets additional HTTP headers sent with every request in this context.

methods.name: setGeolocation
methods.description: Sets or unsets the geolocation for this context, facilitating location-dependent behavior.

methods.name: setHTTPCredentials
methods.description: Sets HTTP authentication credentials for requests in this context. Deprecated.

methods.name: setOffline
methods.description: Emulates offline mode, blocking all network requests.

methods.name: storageState
methods.description: Retrieves current storage state, including cookies and local storage data; can be saved to a file.

methods.name: unroute
methods.description: Removes request routing handlers for matching URLs or handler functions.

methods.name: unrouteAll
methods.description: Removes all request routing handlers from this context.

methods.name: waitForCondition
methods.description: Blocks until a specified condition, often based on page events, is met.

methods.name: waitForConsoleMessage
methods.description: Performs an action and waits for a console message, with optional predicate filtering.

methods.name: waitForEvent
methods.description: Waits for a specific event emitted by the context, with optional predicate filtering.

methods.name: waitForPage
methods.description: Performs an action and waits for a new page to be created, with optional predicate filtering.

methods.name: waitForEvent2
methods.description: Alternate method for waiting for an event, with predicates and timeout options.
